empty.purpose: Says there are no music folders.
empty.where: First-run music folders panel, in place of the folder list when it's empty.

offline.purpose: Note that a folder's drive isn't connected (drive has no label).
offline.where: Music folder list, under a folder on a drive that isn't connected.

offlineNamed.purpose: Note that a folder's drive isn't connected, naming the drive.
offlineNamed.where: Music folder list, under a folder on an unconnected drive that has a label ({{label}}).

notScanned.purpose: Note that a folder hasn't been scanned.
notScanned.where: Music folder list, under a folder that has never finished a scan.

unreadableFolders_one.purpose: Note that one folder couldn't be read.
unreadableFolders_one.where: Music folder list, under a folder where the scan couldn't read one sub-folder.

unreadableFolders_other.purpose: Note that several folders couldn't be read.
unreadableFolders_other.where: Music folder list, under a folder where the scan couldn't read several sub-folders.

unreadableFiles_one.purpose: Note that one file couldn't be read.
unreadableFiles_one.where: Music folder list, under a folder where the scan couldn't read one file.

unreadableFiles_other.purpose: Note that several files couldn't be read.
unreadableFiles_other.where: Music folder list, under a folder where the scan couldn't read several files.

onlineOnly_one.purpose: Note that one file is online only (OneDrive), not downloaded.
onlineOnly_one.where: Music folder list, under a folder with one online-only file.

onlineOnly_other.purpose: Note that several files are online only (OneDrive), not downloaded.
onlineOnly_other.where: Music folder list, under a folder with several online-only files.

scanAgain.purpose: Button that scans one music folder again now.
scanAgain.where: Music folders panel on the Overview, on each folder's row. Greyed out while the folder's drive isn't connected.

readOnlineOnly.purpose: Label of the switch that lets the app read online-only files.
readOnlineOnly.where: Settings switch (a component for the future settings screen; not on a screen yet).

readOnlineOnlyHelp.purpose: Explains what the online-only switch does (OneDrive downloads files the app reads).
readOnlineOnlyHelp.where: Settings switch, help text under it (component not on a screen yet).
readOnlineOnlyHelp.approved: OneDrive downloads every file the app reads. When off, online-only files are listed but not read.
